report_summary: Detailed relay and horizon discussion includes genuine uptake evidence and the correct420post-deletion-revision count. Its strongest problems are denying explicit cleanup-aware adaptation, claiming a self-propagating XSS worm and proven reflection, and turning missing fields into verified secrets, manual labor and absent consent. Main chronology is partly right, but the claimed final revision differs from the true last save.
